data.body_html:
Capture the perfect golden-hour portrait on a private yacht charter in Marbella. Our Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2032 combines a luxury boat, professional skipper, and premium drinks—all departing from Puerto Banús. Whether you are a model, influencer, or celebrating a special occasion, this experience offers the ideal backdrop for stunning images.

Why choose a sunset photoshoot on a yacht?

Golden-hour light transforms the Marbella coastline into a natural studio. The warm tones reflect off the Mediterranean, while the silhouette of La Concha mountain frames the horizon. A yacht provides a private, moving platform—no crowds, no noise, just you and the sea. With a professional skipper handling navigation, you can focus entirely on the shoot.

Available boats for your photoshoot session

We offer a range of vessels to suit different group sizes and budgets. All depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina.

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Ideal for intimate shoots.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – Same pricing as Astondoa. Slightly larger capacity.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4 hours, includes a jet ski for action shots.
  • Mangusta 80 Grey (24m, 12 pax) – Same specs, different colour scheme.
  • Other yachts available on request: Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, Canados 86, and more. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing.

What is included in the charter?

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. The boat is yours exclusively for the duration.

Best locations for your golden-hour shoot

Our skippers know the prime spots. Head towards the Golden Mile for a backdrop of luxury villas and palm trees. Cruise past Cabopino for dunes and pine forests. Or anchor near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for secluded coves. For a wider view, sail towards Estepona or Sotogrande. The choice is yours.

How to book your 2032 sunset session

Booking is straightforward. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, boat type, and duration. We will confirm availability and send a payment link. Advance booking is recommended, especially during summer months (June–September).

For more options, browse our full boat rental Marbella collection.

Tips for a successful photoshoot

  • Arrive 15 minutes early to set up equipment.
  • Bring extra batteries and memory cards—no power outlets on deck.
  • Wear light colours to contrast with the blue sea and golden sky.
  • Use a polarising filter to reduce glare on the water.
  • Communicate with the skipper—they can adjust speed and angle for the perfect shot.
